# Creepy Burnt Ones: New Rewards 2026

![Creepy Scorched: New Rewards 2026](/uploads/14_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**[Update 04/28/2026] New Rewards**

The Spooky Burnt Man seasonal event debuted on Halloween in 2021. The event, like the Hunt for the Treasure Hunter and Holiday Burnt events, consists of random spawns of special enemies that carry a **Legendary item** and a reward. In this case, the reward is a "**scary candy bag**" as well as "**mysterious candy**." This contains, for example, random blueprints, outfits, etc. from the event.

## CURRENT DATES:

- **04/28/2026 6 p.m. - 05/12/2026 6 p.m.**
- **June 25, 2026 6 p.m. - June 26, 2026 6 p.m.**

## SPAWNS & CREEPY CANDY BAG

- Same conditions as the holiday burnt ones
- Anywhere where burnt ones can spawn
- Also at events
- No crafting at the workbench (you cannot buy empty bags at the train stations like in other events)
- No collecting via collector (the scary candy bags cannot be collected through the gift collector)
- The spooky candy bags and mysterious candies are **not tradable** .

## REWARDS

The rewards are divided into Good, Pumpkins and Rare. You have a 50% chance of getting a good reward, a 30% chance of getting rare rewards (blueprints), and a 5% chance of getting pumpkins per candy bag. Also included in the rewards are Contextual Ammo (100% chance), Random Utilities, Random Spirits, Candy & Sugar Bombs (with RAD), and Random Grenades.

A costume is not required when opening or when hunting the Burnt Ones for a better reward.

The rewards themselves are mostly tradable. New rewards are marked.

**The following items and challenges will not be active in the current season in April 2026!**

## CREEPY CANDY BOWL

The spooky candy bowl is available for free in the Atom Shop. You can then set these up in your CAMPs. The bowl can be filled with “mysterious candies”, which you can get from the creepy burned people and buy from many dealers in Appalachia.

Only players wearing a **costume** will receive candy from it!

**Mysterious Candy** randomly gives one of 5 effects:

- Lucky Break: +1 luck for 10 minutes
- Mystery Treat Surprise: You're having a blackout!
- Sugar Rush: +2 Agilty % -1 Intelligence for 10 minutes
- Sugar Strength: +1 Strength for 10 minutes
- Sugar Vision: +1 Perception for 10 minutes
